_week: 2026-11-16 to 2026-11-22 (Week 47). Written from this week's numbers; rewrite every key each Monday.
week_story: Sales rose 40.0% to £2,872 on 122 units (83 last week). The Shoe Cleaner Kit more than doubled to £697 from £276, the Essential Kit grew to £725 from £547 and the 16oz solution to £472 from £314.
The Refresh Kit fell 29% to £225. Ad spend was flat at £897 while ad sales rose 30% to £1,553, so ACoS dropped to 57.7% and TACoS to 31.2%.
refunds: Refunds were £68 on 3 units (2.6% refund rate), up from £0 last week.
pacing_reco: November is £7,598 through Nov 22 (£345 a day), on pace for about £10.4K vs £11.3K in October and 5% behind the same days last year (£8,005). Black Friday week is the chance to close the gap.
